scope: Historical exact attempt-level provider job snapshots; all 28 named bootstrap obligations matched. Pre-export overlap includes legitimate setup/work and is not measured blocked wait. Queue not allocated compute. Active run is partial only. Source changes, export durations, host contention and attempt outcomes confound cross-run comparisons. No claims of achieved B1 savings.

acceptance.required: After candidate qualification, match all 28 names, exact head, complete successful gate/repro, same-run custody; report actual allocation and elapsed separately. Require bootstrap legs start at or after successful export, report post-export queue, full gate wall time and earliest actionable failure, not infer causal savings from overlap. Do not compare active snapshot as final.
